newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo to handle 4 mln containers by 2001-paper.
newsitem.headline: Colombo to handle 4 mln containers by 2001-paper.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Colombo port is expected to handle just over four million twenty-foot equivalent container units (TEUs) by 2001, up from 1.4 million containers in 1996, the government-run Daily News said on Friday.
The newspaper cited shipping industry sources as saying the port was expected to handle 2.10 million TEUs in 1997.

Total containerised cargo handled would rise to 48.2 million tonnes by 2001, up from 25.20 million in 1997. General cargo traffic would increase to 96.5 million tonnes, from 63 million in 1997, it said. It gave no figures for 1996.
Officials were unavailable for comment on the report on Friday because of a public holiday.
